results.title: Europe Should Stop Closing Power Plants, Says U.S. Energy Secretary Wright - WSJ
results.snippet:
Speaking at the U.S.-led Partnership for Transatlantic Energy Cooperation conference in Warsaw, Wright said Western European nations have done too little to grow their energy resources. Too often they have celebrated the closure of power plants as they target lower carbon-dioxide emissions while failing to expand their energy mix, he said.
